summary: The Moto Mods Development Kit was how anyone outside Motorola made a Mod. It pairs a Reference Moto Mod — a working Mod with the microcontroller, the high-speed bridge and the phone-side interface already on it — with a perforated board to solder your own circuit onto, and a cover to put round the result.
